jobs.title: FP&A  Strategy Intern
jobs.description:
About the team

Corporate FP&A is SumUp's internal strategy and finance partner to business leaders— the team that turns data into the decisions that move the business. We build the forecasts, scenario models, and business cases behind capital allocation, reporting strategy, and investor relations. Think of us as an in-house consulting team with a finance lens. As our FP&A Strategy Intern, you'll own real analyses from day one and see your work shape decisions at the leadership level.

You can apply for this role if you are based in Santiago or São Paulo.

What you'll do

- Build and maintain financial and strategic models to evaluate capital allocation trade-offs, market-entry scenarios, and long-range business plans

- Conduct deep-dive analyses on internal data to surface risks, opportunities, and strategic insights that inform executive decision-making

- Drive cross-functional strategy projects — pricing optimisation, revenue growth levers, unit-economics improvement, or cost-efficiency initiatives — and present recommendations to senior leadership

- Develop investment cases and business cases for product launches, geographic expansion, and strategic initiatives, translating complex analysis into clear narratives for board-level reporting

- Design and monitor KPIs, dashboards, and performance frameworks , and contribute to the automation of analytical workflows using modern tools and scripting

You'll be a great fit if…

- You completed (or you're about to complete) a Master's degree in finance, economics, business, engineering, or a quantitative field from a top-tier university

- You think in a structured, hypothesis-driven way — you can take an ambiguous strategic question, break it into a clear issue tree, and drive to a data-backed recommendation

- You've had a first taste of high-impact problem-solving through internships in strategy consulting, corporate strategy, venture capital, growth-stage startups, or investment banking

- You're a strong analytical modeller — confident building scenario analyses and sensitivity models in Google Sheets or Excel, and you can (or want to learn to) automate workflows with Apps Script or Python

- You can tell a crisp, visual story in slides — distilling complex analysis into clear, executive-ready narratives in Google Slides or PowerPoint

- You have solid financial acumen — you understand P&L drivers, unit economics, and how business performance flows through the numbers

Why you should join SumUp

- Work on real strategic questions alongside SumUp's finance leadership — your analysis will feed decisions affecting 4 million+ merchants across 37 markets

- A steep learning curve with direct mentorship from senior FP&A managers who've come from consulting and banking backgrounds

- A role that blends strategy, finance, and data — the kind of experience that accelerates careers in corporate strategy, investing, or operating roles

- Extras like an Urban Sports Club subsidy and subsidised office lunches

- A truly global, multicultural team of 4,000+ SumUppers from 90+ nationalities

At SumUp, we're on a mission to empower small businesses across the globe with simple, affordable tools that help them thrive. Over 4 million businesses across 37 markets rely on SumUp to manage payments, finance, and customer relationships. jobs.title: Fraud Prevention Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
Fraud Prevention Manager

Fraud Prevention team

SumUp's Fraud Prevention team sits at the intersection of risk, data and global payments, moving fast to stay ahead of one of fintech's most dynamic challenges: stopping fraud at scale across multiple markets and products. As the team shifts from a market based to a global, product focused model, this role takes on ownership of the Acquiring domain worldwide, a rare chance to shape a global strategy at a pivotal moment rather than inherit a finished playbook. Reporting directly to the Head of Risk & Fraud Prevention and partnering with a second global fraud prevention manager focused on non acquiring fraud, this is an opportunity to influence how SumUp protects approval rates and merchant trust everywhere it operates.

What you'll do

- Lead a team of fraud specialists through clear goal setting, coaching and strong execution standards, while hiring for open roles and building a culture of ownership.

- Own the global Acquiring fraud strategy roadmap, translating fraud trends, performance data and market needs into rule optimisation, threshold management and authentication strategies.

- Drive the review and testing of Acquiring rules to keep controls effective as fraud patterns evolve.

- Partner with Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Product and regional leaders to prioritise model development and improve fraud tooling.

- Monitor fraud and chargeback performance through KPIs and data analysis, diagnosing root causes and protecting approval rates across all markets.

You'll be great for this role if…

- Proven experience in fraud prevention, fraud strategy or risk management within payments or fintech, including hands on work with rules engines, decision systems or authentication strategies.

- Track record of hiring, coaching and managing performance as an experienced people leader.

- Strong knowledge of working with databases and building KPIs to measure the impact of strategy changes, with SQL or coding skills as a plus.

- Ability to influence and align cross functional teams across Operations, Engineering, Data Science, Product and senior stakeholders, communicating fluently in English.

- A quantitative degree (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Physics or a related field), paired with a growth mindset, quick adaptability and strong prioritisation under pressure.

jobs.description:
Group Financial Controller

Team: Finance, Reporting & Controlling | Location: Sofia, Bulgaria (office first)

Team description

The Group Reporting and Controlling team is the backbone of SumUp's financial integrity, and as the business scales, its role in strengthening governance and reporting standards is becoming more critical than ever. This position gives an experienced controller real ownership over a portfolio of legal entities, direct influence on how SumUp standardises controls and reporting across regions, and a front row seat to the audit and governance work that comes with holding ourselves to the highest financial standards. It's a chance to shape how a fast growing fintech gets its financial house in order, working closely with the Head of Controlling and coordinating directly with external auditors at PwC.

Take a look inside our Sofia office .

What you'll do

- Own statutory audits and reporting compliance for a set of legal entities, including regular financial and balance sheet health checks

- Review accounting entries and reconciliations critically, with a focus on accuracy in high impact areas

- Lead month end closing activities in complex, high judgement areas such as transfer pricing and chargebacks

- Manage the annual closing process for designated entities and financial areas

- Coordinate directly with our external auditors and other stakeholders on audit and technical matters

- Prepare ad hoc reports on legal entity performance and jurisdictional requirements

You'll be great for this role if

- Strong knowledge of financial reporting principles under IFRS and GAAP underpins the way you approach controlling work.

- Experience owning a legal entity end to end, from balance sheet reviews to statutory compliance, comes naturally.

- Comfort working with stakeholders across tax, accounting, FP&A, and audit teams to resolve complex issues.

- Ability to break down ambiguous problems, spot the real blockers, and drive them to resolution.

jobs.title: Business Development Manager – Payments & POS
jobs.description:
Full-Time | 1-Year Fixed Term Contract

Salary: £42,180 + Car Allowance £6,000 + Incidentals £2,160 (OTE £70,360)

High performers can exceed £100K +++

Role overview

SumUp is looking for an experienced, field-based new business hunter to drive net new revenue through the sale of payments and full POS solutions into UK SMBs, with a strong focus on hospitality.

This role suits someone who can confidently prospect, uncover customer needs, deliver high-quality demos, and build a clear value case, all within a short sales cycle.

You’ll own your territory end-to-end, including self-generation, pipeline management, pricing, and closing. This is a role for someone with a strong sense of ownership and an entrepreneurial mindset.

What You’ll Be Doing

- Generate new business through proactive field prospecting, cold outreach, and local networking

- Sell payments and POS solutions to SMB merchants, particularly in hospitality

- Target established businesses (typically £25k+ monthly TPV)

- Run structured discovery to understand how a business operates and identify opportunities

- Deliver tailored product demonstrations across POS and payments

- Lead pricing discussions and close using a consultative, value-led approach

- Manage your pipeline, forecasting, and activity in line with SumUp standards

- Build and leverage referrals from your merchant base and local network

Who we’re looking for

- Minimum 2 years proven B2B new business field sales experience

- Most recent roles must be primarily new business

- Proven experience selling into SMB customers (territory-based selling)

- Experience in merchant services/payments and/or POS is strongly preferred

- Other relevant technical or hospitality-adjacent field sales will be considered

- A genuine self-starter

- Full UK driving licence

What Will Make You Successful

- A “hunter” mindset: enjoys field intensity, door-to-door prospecting, and building business in the territory

- Strong commercial judgement and value / pricing ownership

- High activity with discipline: creates volume while keeping quality

- Can adapt: able to move a merchant from simple devices toward more complete POS/payments solutions

Ready to take ownership of your territory and maximise your earning potential? Apply now and let’s have a conversation.

jobs.title: Director of Sales, North and Central Europe
jobs.description:
Director of Sales, North & Central Europe

Location: London, United Kingdom (office based)

Team description

North & Central Europe is one of SumUp's biggest and most competitive sales regions, spanning the UK, Ireland, the Netherlands, Germany, Austria and Switzerland. As the region has grown, we've moved from a country led model to a structure where sales leaders each specialise in one channel across the region, giving them the focus to go deeper while staying joined up across markets.

This role sits above that structure as the single owner of commercial performance across the region: deciding where budget and capacity should go, setting the pace on forecasting and pipeline discipline, and developing the leadership team behind ambitious growth targets.

It's a rare opportunity to shape a brand new regional structure from the ground up, working across some of SumUp's most complex and most competitive markets, while staying close enough to the field to inspire teams and help them solve their toughest problems.

What you'll do

- Own commercial performance across all sales channels in the region, working closely with sales leaders to spot opportunities for markets and channels to perform even better, and turning those insights into practical plans that lift results

- Build a clear go to market plan for the region that accounts for local competition and market maturity

- Decide where to invest budget and hiring capacity across markets and channels, and reallocate resource towards the areas delivering the strongest returns

- Support and develop senior sales leaders to strengthen pipeline leadership, accelerate performance, and ensure long-term succession

- Spend regular time in the field and in local sales offices, working directly alongside reps and managers to stay close to what's actually happening on the ground

You'll be great for this role if

- You have proven ownership of regional or business level commercial outcomes, with a track record of turning around underperformance rather than only scaling something that already worked

- You have strong commercial understanding of SMB sales, ideally gained through high exposure to sales environments such as payments, fintech or another SMB technology sector

- You have extensive experience leading senior sales leaders, including setting targets, forecasting, and allocating budget and capacity across several markets

- You're comfortable operating across both strategy and execution, including regular travel and time spent on the sales floor rather than working from behind a desk

- You have an ability to build trust quickly with senior stakeholders, inspire teams towards more ambitious targets, and hold people accountable for delivering on them

Why you should join SumUp

Credit will be a key strategic priority within the role. 👉 Get a feel for life in our São Paulo office .

- Lead growth across SumUp’s full product portfolio in Brazil, with a particular focus on credit/lending products.

At SumUp, our People Operations & Payroll team is the engine behind a smooth and reliable employee experience. We manage the full employee lifecycle — from onboarding and contract changes through to offboarding — while supporting accurate and timely payroll across Southern Europe.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Manager - B2C
jobs.description:
Senior Marketing Manager - Consumer

About the team

SumUp is building a consumer financial product with a distribution advantage that almost no other fintech can replicate.

More than four million merchants use SumUp, and more than a billion consumers come into contact with our products each year. We now have the opportunity to turn that reach into one of the world's largest consumer financial ecosystems.

Our consumer product is already live across six European markets. The next challenge is to grow it from an emerging proposition into a product used by millions of consumers, and this role will lead that journey.

This role sits at the heart of that growth. As Senior Marketing Manager (Merchant to Consumer) , you'll drive the merchant-to-consumer acquisition engine: the channel that converts SumUp's merchant network and their customers into SumUp personal banking customers.  This is a rare chance to build a differentiated acquisition channel from scratch inside a small, ambitious team, competing head-to-head with some of the best-funded neobanks in Europe.

What you'll do

- Plan and execute merchant-to-consumer acquisition campaigns across six markets — owning messaging, creative strategy, localisation, and performance reporting

- Embed consumer sign-up moments into merchant touchpoints, including the super app, card readers, merchant CRM, and merchant website

- Drive cross-sell from SumUp Local into the consumer banking app, managing conversion, activation, and incentives for consumers coming through merchant-led channels

- Work closely with teams across Hardware, CRM, and other business lines to get consumer acquisition placements shipped through channels you don't directly own

- Build and maintain reporting on merchant-to-consumer acquisition performance, using it to inform channel-mix decisions and prove cost-per-customer against direct advertising

You'll be great for this role if…

- Strong B2C growth or lifecycle marketing experience, ideally in fintech, payments, retail, or a marketplace

- Proven track record of planning and executing campaigns across multiple markets, including localisation and creative direction

- Experience marketing through partner or owned channels, such as CRM, in-product surfaces, or point-of-sale,  rather than relying solely on paid media

- Comfort owning acquisition metrics, attribution, and reporting end to end, with a data-driven and commercially minded approach

- Ability to influence and coordinate across matrixed teams to get placements and campaigns shipped without direct authority

Territory Sales Manager hos SumUp!

🌍 Placering: København, Danmark

Hos SumUp er vi en global fintech-virksomhed dedikeret til at hjælpe små virksomheder med at trives. Vi opererer i over 30 lande og tilbyder enkle, overkommelige og innovative betalingsløsninger — fra kortlæsere til erhvervskonti og onlinebutikker. Med over 4 millioner handlende verden over er vores mission at styrke lokale iværksættere og skabe en verden, hvor alle kan drive forretning med lethed og selvtillid.

Vi søger en dynamisk salgsleder, der trives i felten, bygger fra bunden og ved, hvordan man skalerer vindende teams. Hos SumUp styrker vi små handlende i hele Danmark, og vi leder efter entreprenørielle Field Sales Team Leads til at udvide vores tilstedeværelse i nøgleregioner.

🔥 Din mission:

- Led fra fronten: Sælg aktivt SumUps POS-systemer og kortlæsere i felten for at opbygge en dyb markedsforståelse

- Byg og led: Rekruttér, onboard og coachét et team på 10–15 selvstændige provisionbaserede Field Sales Representatives

- Skalér med gennemslagskraft: Lancér og udbyg vores tilstedeværelse på tværs af flere byer og territorier

- Driv performance: Sæt klare mål, monitorér KPI'er og forbedr løbende salgskonvertering og teamets output

- Agér som en grundlægger: Vær den lokale ekspert, repræsentér brandet og samarbejd tæt med HQ-teams om at levere strategiske indsigter

🧠 Vi leder efter én, der:

- Har en stærk track record inden for feltsalg og direkte salg

- Har erfaring med at opbygge og lede freelance- eller provisionbaserede salgsteams

- Er entreprenøriel, drevet og trives i tempofyldte miljøer

- Forstår behovene hos små virksomheder og lokale markeder

- Er resultatorienteret og drives af at nå ambitiøse mål

- Er fortrolig med CRM og salgsværktøjer til datadrevne beslutninger

🎁 Hvad vi tilbyder:

- Attraktiv kompensation: Konkurrencedygtig grundløn + ubegrænsede provisioner

- Fleksibel arbejdsmodel: 70–80% feltbaseret arbejde på tværs af regionen

- Autonomi: En rolle med stort ansvar, hvor du ejer dit territorium og dine resultater

Hos SumUp er vi stolte af at være en arbejdsgiver med lige muligheder for alle. Vi værdsætter mangfoldige perspektiver og erfaringer — er du motiveret, kompetent og begejstret for vores mission, opfordrer vi dig til at ansøge, selv hvis du ikke opfylder hvert eneste krav.

Lad os vokse sammen!

Territory Strategy, Market Penetration, Revenue Growth, Strategic Planning, Resource Allocation

We want to build the commercial engine behind SumUp's merchant relationships. The new Customer Success Management function within the SumUp Operations Tribe will span early activation, product onboarding, customer success, account management, and key account management across multiple markets in a fast growing organisation.

This is a newly created VP role with a clear mandate: build the leadership structure, operating rhythm, and commercial culture that takes the Operations-led team from where it is today to where it needs to be. You'll have real ownership, a strong foundation to build on, and direct influence over how millions of small businesses experience SumUp.

- Own the full merchant growth lifecycle — from early activation and onboarding through to retention, upsell, and key account management — setting the strategy and driving execution across all customer segments

- Drive performance across key metrics including net revenue per rep, merchant activation rates, and health scores — using data to identify opportunities and course-correct quickly

- Represent the commercial voice of the SumUp merchant base at senior leadership level, translating insight into product and strategy decisions that improve onboarding and retention
